title: Insulin Resistance in Idiopathic Oligospermia and Azoospermia
brief_summary: Insulin resistance in men can be the underlying major factor in reproductive abnormalities ( chronic hypospermatogenesis ) as well as metabolic abnormalities similar to polycystic ovarian syndrome ( PCOS ) in women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* sperm count less than 10 million per milliliter
* non-obstructive azoospermia

Exclusion Criteria:

* high FSH ( \> 10 mIU/ ml )
* high prolactin ( \> 36 mIU/ml )
* abnormal karyotype
* AZF
